name: Van Long
kicker: Wetland boat north of the karst
summary: A boat through the wetland north of the valley. An adult pays 100,000 đồng and a child pays 50,000 đồng. The wetland covers 2,736 ha at xã Gia Vân, huyện Gia Viễn. It is recorded as a Ramsar site in 2017 and in 2019, Vietnam’s 9th, and the 2nd of the Red River Delta. Hang Cá, Hang Bóng, and Hang Rùa sit on the water, with voọc mông trắng named among the animals.
dotReason: The other boat, a half day away from the Sao Khe
getThere: A ride north of the karst valley, to xã Gia Vân in huyện Gia Viễn.
heroCaption: Wetland water and limestone at Vân Long

notice.title: Two years and two place names
notice.body: The Ramsar year is given as 10 February 2017 and as 2019. The address is both xã Gia Vân and huyện Gia Viễn.

body: The visit is a boat among limestone in the wetland. The caves named on the water are Hang Cá, Hang Bóng, and Hang Rùa, and the animal named with them is voọc mông trắng. The area is 2,736 ha. It became Vietnam’s 9th Ramsar site, and the 2nd of the Red River Delta, with the year given as 2019 and the designation date also given as 10 February 2017. The wetland point with that date is 20°23′35″N 105°51′10″E.

The hero frame is water, reeds, and the cliff. The second frame is the landing: sampans on the wetland with the karst behind them. The ticket hotline is 0963 106 222. The support phone is 0915.431.058.

figures.caption: Sampans on the Vân Long wetland, with the karst behind the landing
figures.alt: Wooden boats on a wetland channel with limestone hills at Vân Long

gettingThere: North of the Tràng An valley. Ask for xã Gia Vân or huyện Gia Viễn. Both names are in use for the same wetland.

legs.heading: From Ninh Binh
legs.body: A ride from the station or the valley to Gia Vân. The boat is the visit once you are at the landing.

admissionNote: Adult 100,000 đồng. Child 50,000 đồng, with no height on that line. Hotline 0963 106 222. Support phone 0915.431.058.
